summary.zh: 提 issue 和评论现在支持上传图片了，报 bug 贴截图不用再绕道图床。注意：附件图片保存在开发者提供的图床服务，单个账号每日限 50 张，请勿上传隐私截图。
summary.en: Issue and comment image attachments are here — no more external image hosting for bug reports. Note: images are stored on a developer-provided image host (50 uploads/account/day). Avoid posting private screenshots.

items.zh: 新增：提 issue 和发评论支持上传图片，自动以图片形式展示
items.en: Attach images to new issues and comments; they render inline

items.zh: 删除或编辑带图内容时自动清理图床数据
items.en: Image hosting data is cleaned up when content is deleted or edited

items.zh: 图片上传支持进度显示、失败重试，超过 2 MB 的图会在选择时提示
items.en: Upload progress, retry on failure, and a 2 MB per-image limit
